Title: VDA 55005
Description: Label for VDA 55005 with size A5(210*148mm) using action ZHU_VDA_FORMS
Condition To Print: Label is printed upon HU weigh update

Additional Info.Printer: Printer to be obtained from condition record
Additional Info.Details:
Table ZT0430 is to be maintained with Ship to party based on which the following fields are customized.
2. Truncate HU to 9 characters.
3. Date format with D suffix in DDMMYY format.
4. Unloading point after colon (:) is printed. Supplier code from ZED1 text is printed.
5. Delivery number is truncated to the last 8 characters.
